To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the number of articles using inductive methods in AOMJ has increased over time, 2) inductive methods are more common in articles published in AOMJ than in other journals, 3) the use of inductive methods has increased over time for all journals in our sample, 4) the most common inductive method in our sample is qualitative analysis, 5) qualitative analysis is more common in articles using inductive approaches than in articles using deductive approaches,
(1) inductive methods can be used to address grand challenges, and (2) inductive methods are not inferior to deductive methods.
(a) inductive methods are a useful approach to address grand challenges in management, and (b) the use of inductive methods in the management field is limited.
